commit_message.prompt: Write the commit message in English using ASCII characters only (no CJK, no accented or non-ASCII characters). Use the conventional commits format: a subject line "Type(scope): summary" (Type in feat/fix/chore/docs/refactor/test/perf) and, for non-trivial changes, a blank line followed by a body explaining what changed and why. Match the repo's existing commit message style. The pre-commit and commit-msg hooks reject non-ASCII content, so verify the message is pure ASCII.

commit.template: Stage the relevant changes, inspect `git status` and `git diff`, then commit with a message written in English using ASCII characters only (no CJK, no accented letters), following the repo style `Type(scope): summary`. Never commit secrets; only stage what the user asked for.
commit.description: Stage and commit with an English-only message
